test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: JNLO is related to ILIK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, NRPS is related to MPMO. To which of the following is LPNQ related, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic: Increasing number series is subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series. ​​So, JNLO is related to ILIK ​
